title: THE MIGHTY BOOSH
tickerText:
WELCOME TO THE MIGHTY BOOSH! STEP INSIDE A WORLD WHERE NOTHING MAKES SENSE, EVERYTHING IS POSSIBLE AND EVEN THE MOON HAS SOMETHING TO SAY!

CREATED BY NOEL FIELDING AND JULIAN BARRATT, THIS GLORIOUSLY BONKERS BRITISH COMEDY PHENOMENON FIRST HIT BBC TELEVISION IN 2004 AND QUICKLY BECAME A CULT CLASSIC.

MEET VINCE NOIR, THE GLAM-ROCK FASHION OBSESSIVE, AND HOWARD MOON, THE JAZZ-LOVING MISFIT WITH DELUSIONS OF GRANDEUR. JOINED BY NABOO THE ENIGMA, BOLLO THE GORILLA AND THE COMPLETELY UNHINGED BOB FOSSIL, THEIR ADVENTURES ARE ANYTHING BUT ORDINARY!

FROM ZOOS AND JUNGLES TO THE ARCTIC TUNDRA AND THE LEGENDARY NABOOTIQUE, EXPECT TALKING ANIMALS, BIZARRE CREATURES, RIDICULOUS MUSICAL NUMBERS AND SOME OF THE STRANGEST CHARACTERS EVER UNLEASHED ON TELEVISION.

REMEMBER OLD GREGG? THE HITCHER? THE CRIMPING? THE MOON'S CHEEKY LITTLE FACE?

WITH THREE SERIES, LIVE STAGE SHOWS AND A DEVOTED GLOBAL FOLLOWING, THE BOOSH REDEFINED SURREAL COMEDY FOR AN ENTIRE GENERATION.

SO GRAB YOUR EELS, PUT ON YOUR BEST GLITTER AND PREPARE TO JOURNEY INTO THE WONDERFULLY WEIRD WORLD OF THE MIGHTY BOOSH!
